scripts.db:migrate: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T api pnpm run db:migrate
scripts.db:generate: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml exec api pnpm run db:generate
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infrastructure/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T api pnpm run db:reset && bash scripts/seed-database.sh

auditConfig.//: brace-expansion DoS advisories. Only reachable via dev/build-time tooling (eslint plugins' minimatch@3.1.5; @sentry/webpack-plugin's glob>minimatch@8) — no production request path. GHSA-mh99's OOM fix exists only in brace-expansion 5.0.8, whose ESM-interop CJS build (exports.expand) breaks the older minimatch that calls require('brace-expansion') as a bare function; the 1.x/2.x lines have no OOM-guarded release. Overrides below already pin every consumer to the max-safe version. Revisit when eslint plugins / @sentry drop the old minimatch/glob chain.
